core_principles.text: The movement is started when the elbow joint is in full extension and the forearm is flexed until dumbbells reach the top of the shoulders.
The elbows keep close to the body during the movement.

specific_findings.text: In a simulation of dumbbell curls performed with 6 kg and 10.7 kg, although the load increased by 78.3%, the rate of increase of elbow peak moment was 57.7% and the rate of increase of peak muscle force was 38.3%.
When increasing the dumbbell load from 6 kg to 10.7 kg, the rate of increase of maximum strain and maximum stress in the biceps brachii are 44.4% and 37.3%, respectively.
Increasing the dumbbell load does not increase the muscle force at the same rate.
